newsitem.title: USA: First Union files small shelf offering.
newsitem.headline: First Union files small shelf offering.

text.p: First Union Corp said Thursday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $1 million in preferred securities and debentures.
Companies on occasion will file a registration for a nomimal amount and then amend it in the future to reflect a larger amount of securities to be sold.
The company said the preferred securities will be sold by three business trusts formed by First Union called First Union Capital I, First Union Capital II and First Union Capital III.

Proceeds from the sale of the preferred securities will be invested in First Union's junior subordinated debentures and then First Union will use those proceeds for general corporate purposes., the filing said.
The offering will be made through Morgan Stanley & Co and Goldman Sachs & Co, the filing said.
The corporation is a Charlotte, North Carolina-based, multi-bank holding company and provides a wide range of commercial and retail banking services.
